name: Kotaku

sources.title: Kotaku homepage — live gaming publication (reviews, news, tips); footer 'Send us a Tip!' link is a Cloudflare-obfuscated email resolving to tips@kotaku.com

requirements: Not a directory — earned editorial only; no listing product
Kotaku covers video games and gaming culture — a SaaS product is essentially out of scope unless it is a game or game-adjacent tool
News tips go to tips@kotaku.com (obfuscated 'Send us a Tip!' email link in the site footer)
Recent Kotaku articles actively solicit tips at tips@kotaku.com (referenced in 2026 coverage of Epic layoffs)
preparation: A gaming-industry hook — game launch, studio news, industry leak — not a generic SaaS announcement
Concise tip: claim, evidence, why it matters to Kotaku's audience
workflow: Send the tip or press release to tips@kotaku.com
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written article — no listing page is created
watchFor: Weak fit for SaaS launches — Kotaku's remit is games and gamer culture; a productivity tool will be ignored
tips@ is read by reporters — anything sent may be published
Part of the ex-G/O Media network (Kotaku USA LLC); sister sites share sensibilities but have separate inboxes
countsAsLive: A Kotaku article mentioning the product/game is published at kotaku.com
unknowns: Review-copy intake process for indie games — not documented on public pages
Whether freelance pitches are accepted — no contributor guidelines page found
